headline: PTC Industries Secures 400-Ton Titanium Supply Order for Defence
summary: Engineering components producer PTC Industries received a contract to supply 400 metric tons of titanium materials for high-strength defense applications.
why: PTC Industries manufactures high-precision metal castings and components for defense and aerospace sectors.

impacts.name: PTC Industries
impacts.why: PTC Industries shares rose 1.4% after winning a 400-tonne titanium defense contract.
